meta: How to write a description so AI makes the image you want: a short sentence usually gives a bland picture, because AI has to guess almost everything.

muc.title: Short description, bland image
muc.text: Type just a short sentence and the image usually comes out bland, because AI has to guess almost everything.

muc.title: Who or what, doing what
muc.text: Start with the subject, the main person or thing: what it looks like and what it's doing. The more specific, the better.

muc.title: Place and light
muc.text: Add the setting and light, like a porch in the early morning, golden afternoon sun or a warm desk lamp on a rainy night.

muc.title: Choose a style
muc.text: Finally the style, like a photo, a watercolor or a cartoon, plus a vertical or horizontal frame.

muc.title: Change one part, see the difference
muc.text: Write a description with subject, setting, light and style, make one image, then change one part and compare.
